name: Manitoba
title: Manitoba Rebate Calculator 2026: Efficiency Manitoba Rebates
h1: Manitoba Rebate Calculator 2026: What You Could Get Back
desc: Free Manitoba rebate calculator. Efficiency Manitoba heat pump, window, thermostat and insulation rebates, plus free upgrades for lower incomes. Every number sourced.
intro: Answer a few questions and see which Manitoba rebates fit your home, with a source for every number.
short: Efficiency Manitoba pays $2,000 for a ducted cold climate heat pump and $1,500 for a ductless one, $100 for each triple pane window or door, and $50 for a smart thermostat. Income-qualifying households can get free or subsidized upgrades. Get approval before insulation work starts.
faq: How much is the Manitoba heat pump rebate?

$2,000 for a centrally ducted cold climate air source heat pump and $1,500 for a ductless one. It must supplement electric or natural gas heat, or replace propane or oil, in an existing primary home, installed by a registered contractor.
Is there help for lower-income Manitobans?

Yes. The Energy Efficiency Assistance Program gives free and subsidized upgrades to income-qualifying households in single-detached or semi-detached homes. The limit is $46,264 for one person and $122,432 for seven or more.
How much is the window and door rebate?
$100 for each ENERGY STAR certified window, entry door or sliding glass door with at least triple pane glass. Apply within 90 days.
Do I need approval before insulation work?
Yes. Efficiency Manitoba says to get approval before buying materials or starting any work, including removing drywall or old insulation.
